title: Plan Administration Rule: The Months of a Term Treated as Still to Run
content:
Where a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is given up, the whole months of its term still to run are worked out against the inspection record, because the months the coverage was not answering are not returned.

Where the whole months since the most recent inspection entry exceed the coverage's inspection interval and the plan has run beyond its first coverage year of 12 months, the months still to run are the coverage's term less the whole months since the plan was bought and less the whole months by which the inspection stands overdue. The whole months by which the inspection stands overdue are the whole months since the most recent inspection entry beyond that interval, and never less than nothing. Where the whole months since the most recent inspection entry are within the coverage's inspection interval and the plan has run beyond its first coverage year of 12 months, the months still to run are the coverage's term less the whole months since the plan was bought, the month in progress counting as still to run. In any other case the months still to run are the coverage's term less the whole months since the plan was bought and less the month in progress.

## Where the plan falls

| Whole months since the most recent inspection entry | Whole months since the plan was bought | The months still to run |
|---|---|---|
| more than the coverage's inspection interval | more than 12 | the term, less the months since purchase, less the months the inspection stands overdue |
| the interval or fewer | more than 12 | the term, less the months since purchase |
| any | 12 or fewer | the term, less the months since purchase, less the month in progress |

## The inspection interval each plan sets

| Plan | Inspection interval, whole months |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | 12 |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | 6 |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | 6 |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | 6 |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | 6 |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | 4 |

## Worked readings

A plan of 36 months bought 20 whole months ago, on an interval of 6 months, whose most recent inspection entry is 9 whole months old: the inspection stands 3 whole months overdue, and the months still to run are 36 less 20 less 3, being 13. The same plan whose most recent inspection entry is 4 whole months old: the months still to run are 36 less 20, being 16. The same plan handled 8 whole months after purchase: the months still to run are 36 less 8 less the month in progress, being 27.
